description: This source file defines a PHP class 'TimesheetDateRule' that extends an abstract validation rule class. The class implements validation logic to check whether a given date satisfies certain criteria related to timesheets for a specific employee number, ensuring the date is not in the future and a timesheet for that date and employee doesn't already exist.

classes.name: TimesheetDateRule
classes.description: A validation rule class that checks if a given date is not in the future and no timesheet exists for the employee on that date.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the employee number for the validation rule.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates if the input date is not in the future and no existing timesheet is recorded for the employee on that date.
